parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-30, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 74.2 | 15.31 | 15.31
2 | 27.3 | 18.79 | 34.10
3 | 76.3 | 5.06 | 39.16
4 | 96.3 | 4.07 | 43.23
5 | 138.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as K-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-30, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-30 (Survey Area T)**

Station T-30 exhibits a 5-layer geoelectric sequence:
- **Layer 1:** 74.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 15.31 m (topsoil/unsaturated zone).
- **Layer 2:** 27.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 18.79 m (depth to base 34.10 m), representing a weathered, water-bearing target zone.
- **Layer 3:** 76.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 5.06 m (depth to base 39.16 m).
- **Layer 4:** 96.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 4.07 m (depth to base 43.23 m).
- **Layer 5:** 138.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (fresh basement from 43.23 m depth).

**Curve Type Evaluation:**
The resistivity progression is $\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$. Evaluating consecutive three-layer triplets yields H ($\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$), A ($\rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4$), and A ($\rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$), defining an **HAA-type** curve. The on-file classification as K-type is incorrect.

{"curve_type_stated": "HAA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
